enable_jetstream.description: Enable JetStream functionality in NATS server.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) JetStream may use for memory-backed streams.

max_storage.description: Maximum total storage (in bytes) JetStream may use for disk-backed streams.

storage_dir.description: Directory path where JetStream persists stream data (for disk storage).

max_ack_pending.description: Maximum number of unacknowledged messages allowed per consumer.

mem_max_stream_bytes.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for a memory-backed stream.

storage_max_stream_bytes.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for a disk-backed stream.

stream_defaults_enabled.description: Enable application of default settings to all newly created streams.

max_consumers.description: Default maximum number of consumers per stream.

max_msg_size.description: Default maximum message size (in bytes) for streams.

max_bytes.description: Default total storage limit per stream (e.g., '1G', '100M'). Use -1 for unlimited.

max_age.description: Default maximum message age (e.g., '1h', '72h') before auto-expiration.

duplicate_window.description: Default time window to track duplicate messages (to avoid re-delivery of duplicates).

allow_rollup.description: Allow stream rollups (aggregate/summarize data via rollup subjects) by default.

deny_delete.description: Prevent direct message deletion in new streams by default.

deny_purge.description: Prevent stream purging (deletion of all messages) by default.

streams.description: List of custom JetStream streams to define (beyond defaults). Each stream must have a name and at least one subject.

subjects.description: List of subject patterns this stream captures.

max_messages_per_subject.description: Limit messages per subject (for subject-limited streams).

max_msgs.description: Maximum total messages to retain in this stream.

discard.description: Discard policy when limits reached: 'old' (delete oldest), 'new' (reject new).

deny_delete.description: Disable direct deletes for this stream.

deny_purge.description: Disable stream purges for this stream.

num_replicas.description: Replication factor (1 = no HA, 3 = typical HA, 5 = high durability).

peers.description: List of cluster peers (other NATS servers in the cluster).

system_account.description: Enable system account for JetStream admin and monitoring.

system_password.description: Password for the system account user (change in production!).
